newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jinwei Textile to issue A shares in November.
newsitem.headline: Jinwei Textile to issue A shares in November.

text.p: Jinwei Textile Machinery Co Ltd expects to issue 23 million A shares next month in Shenzhen to tap funds held by mainland Chinese investors, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The issue, approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, has been tentatively priced at between four and five yuan per share, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Shanghai Guotai Securities has been appointed chief underwriter for the issue and the A shares would be listed in Shenzhen, he said.
Jinwei has total share capital of 400.8 million shares, including 220 million state shares and 180.8 million H shares.
The H shares were issued at HK$1.29 per share and listed on the Hong Kong bourse in February this year.
The official said that, if the A share offer went through, Jinwei planned to use the proceeds to develop a new line of textile machinery.
Jinwei, based in Yuci city in Shanxi province, had audited after-tax profits of 68 million yuan last year, compared with 44.98 million in 1994, according to the official.
He did not say whether the figures were compiled under Chinese accounting standards. Jinwei is forecasting net earnings of about 80 million yuan this year, he said.
